Conservation Area, Surface
...This is the place. Thank you, 【kuroname】. You truly are the hero everyone speaks so fondly of.
The cloaked "refugee" leads you into a secluded house. His posture is hunched, and he has been facing away from you the entire time since he entered.

Having completed a mission, you were resting at a nearby conservation area earlier today when this refugee showed up. Claiming that an Ascendant had been spotted near his home, he sought help from the renowned commandant.
His dwelling is certainly isolated. Tucked away far from any crowds, this area is practically deserted.

Creeeeak—the door suddenly slams shut behind you the moment you step inside the dim little cottage, plunging the interior into complete darkness. The atmosphere grows eerie.
So where's this Ascendant you mentioned?
Well... I'm afraid this humble one doesn't know either. Perhaps that door just now was the Ascendant's doing. How terrifying... O esteemed Gray Raven Commandant, you simply must protect me...
I see. And what's my next line supposed to be?
"Cunning Ascendant, I've seen through your disguise!"
Could you switch it up next time, Roland?
Roland
—But the legendary Gray Raven Commandant falls for it every time, no?
He removes the cloak that has been concealing his face and meets your gaze.
Alright, what have you planned this time?
Roland
Oh? Getting into character already? Or have you just gotten used to the surprises I arrange for you?
Roland
Trusting an Ascendant so readily, letting your guard down... That's a bit out of character for you, isn't it, Gray Raven Commandant?
But I trust you.
I can take care of myself even if things go wrong.
Roland
...Is this your gift in return, 【kuroname】? "Trust"... a precious gift indeed.
Roland
Of course... No one should underestimate the all-capable Gray Raven Commandant.
Roland
Now that the actors are in place, let's... raise the curtain.
Roland
Let us step into the tale, and share this lovely evening together.

Snap! With a flick of his fingers, the lights blaze to life, revealing the decorations that were concealed in the dark. Roses surround an intricate stage, and every detail speaks to the care that has been put into this.
Roland
Welcome back to your temple, divine Gray Raven—that's the role you'll be playing today, 【kuroname】.
Roland
You've lived on this hidden island since your birth, worshipped by mortals, yet forbidden to leave. The divine must be irreproachable at all times, after all.
Roland
Yet the divine form also holds a fatal allure for mortals. Two exceptional individuals braved countless trials to reach your island and became your devoted followers and suitors...

Roland bows, gesturing to his right with courtly grace. Understanding his cue, you step calmly to his side into the spot he has reserved for you. Standing together, you now share the same pool of light and shadow.
He produces a puppet from behind his back that is adorned with a sash that marks it as a knight. He will be using it to perform the next act.
"Knight"
I am your devoted follower, my divine... I am a knight who has journeyed here in pursuit of your divine presence.
"Knight"
By the grace of your decree, I am permitted to enter your sanctum during the day to behold your sacred form and fortify the barrier that protects your temple.
"Knight"
Mine is the oath of "protection." So long as I can safeguard your sacred throne, my humble adoration for you will be soothed.
With that, the puppet bows and executes a perfect knightly salute, his form reverent and dignified.

Faced with this impromptu performance, you are unsure how to respond. Fortunately, the seasoned actor across from you has already prepared for this, smoothly transitioning into the next scene without missing a beat.

Roland sweeps his hand, and the curtain at his side shifts to a nighttime backdrop. Simultaneously, the puppet in his grasp changes into one that is dressed in finer garments and wearing a crown.
"Prince"
A coward like him has no right to serve you beside me. Pay no mind to such a lowly insect, my divine.
"Prince"
As a prince from a neighboring kingdom, I have long admired you from afar, so I have come to this island in hopes of remaining at your side.
"Prince"
By your divine decree, the hours after nightfall belong to me. During that time, only the two of us will be in this sanctum.
"Prince"
Mine is the oath of "possession." I possess a vast kingdom, land, power... and in time, I hope to possess your affection as well.

Roland has fully immersed himself in the role. Unlike the knight's humble reverence, he converses with you as your equal, standing proudly, taking your hand, and bringing it to his lips for a gentle kiss.
So what do you want "Gray Raven" to do?
Is this a classic dilemma where I must choose?
Roland
Wise as always. Every great show needs its rising action and turning point.
He sets down the puppet, signaling his shift from a character into the neutral narrator.
Roland
The story should have quietly awaited its conclusion as these two devotees pursued their love, but... a complication arose.
Roland
Fiends escaped from hell and ran rampant, and the chaos even reached the divine's island. The sanctum was on the verge of collapse and was no longer safe.
Roland
Revered "Gray Raven", you must make your choice.
"Knight"
I will escort you to safety so you may leave this place and seek refuge in another paradise. But I must stay behind and use my own body and life to form the barrier that holds back the fiends.
"Prince"
I can summon my kingdom's army to repel the fiends, but once they enter the island, this land must become part of my domain. You would have to rule alongside me, forever bound to this place.
Roland
My divine... What will you choose? "Protection," or "possession"?
He has brought the story to its climax, but both choices he offers seem to lead to tragedy. Rather than pick one of the two options, you study Roland carefully for a moment before stepping closer.
Roland
He can already guess what you intend to do, but he does not stop you. Instead, he allows you to take the puppet from his hand—just one puppet.
The two sides of the puppet clearly correspond to the "Knight" and "Prince" from the story. They share the same vessel, merely playing different roles during the day and night.
They were always the same person, weren't they?
Why would he split himself into two identities?
Roland
...Because nothing in this world is ever perfect. That was the price the divine's decree demanded for him to set foot on the island.
Roland
He could meet the deity he adored in both day and night, yet he would always appear incomplete.
Roland
Of course, it was still him who chose his path. He decided to split his feelings for the divine into two separate roads and took each to its extreme...
Roland

He was gambling that one of them would win the divine's favor. Mortals and gods belong to different worlds, and to claim this love he yearned for, he must pay a price if he dreamed of being the divine's equal.
Roland

Inferiority? Or a clear-eyed understanding? For him, it was also an escape route, a way to avoid complete humiliation. Better to fall with your eyes open than waste away pining for something that would never be.
Roland
He knew this all too well. "Protection"<sacrifice> and "possession"<control> would both inevitably end in tragedy. A mortal in love with the divine could never have a happy ending.
Roland
And so the play reaches its final act. If it's too tragic for you, just think of yourself as a spectator, 【kuroname】.
Roland
It was just improvisation on my part. There's no need to take it too seriously.
But I want to give him a better ending.
If you're part of the story, I don't want to be sidelined.
You adjust the puppet's sash and crown, bringing them to the same side and making him whole again. No longer split between the knight and the prince, he is just himself.
Just be yourself. You don't have to lose anything.
To stay or to leave... the choice is yours.
And the "divine" will always be with you.
Roland
...Then my choice is... to love.
Roland holds up the now-complete puppet and snaps his fingers toward the door. It swings open, but he remains at the center of his ornate, lonesome stage with no intention of leaving.
Roland
The disaster descending upon the island couldn't be avoided, so I must stay behind to secure your escape, my divine.
Roland
But there's no need for regret. This is something beyond "sacrifice" and "control"... The divine's love has wrought a miracle, and my soul is whole.
Roland
Let my body remain on this shattered island, while my complete soul and love follow you to a vaster beyond.
Roland
That's the end of tonight's performance, and it's quite satisfying... So take this love and go, 【kuroname】.
Roland
The souls of both the knight and the prince will be forever loyal to you.
